tagline: Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations.
hero_kpi_rationale: Operating margin is Leidos' key KPI because it reflects the company's ability to convert its substantial government revenues into sustainable profits, demonstrating operational efficiency and cost discipline critical in its competitive environment.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by revenue, indicating profitability from core operations.
kpis.description: Reflects the company's ability to generate profits from its core business activities.
kpis.signal: Growth in operating profitability driven by effective management.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of income generated from the sale of goods and services.
kpis.description: A key indicator of the size and growth of the company's business.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth, supported by new contracts and volume increases.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Measures direct profitability of the company's activities before accounting for other expenses.

kpis.name: Government Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue derived from contracts with the U.S. government.
kpis.description: Indicator of revenue concentration with U.S. government clients, the primary growth driver.
kpis.signal: High and stable reliance on government contracts, primarily with DoD and Intelligence Community.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Represents the size of the company's workforce, a key factor for execution capacity.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount, indicating a consolidation phase following growth.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from core operations before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Measures profitability from the company's core operations.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in operating income due to contract wins and volume increases.

kpis.name: National Security Digital Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin of the National Security Digital segment, which provides advanced technology services to federal government clients.
kpis.description: Indicator of the National Security Digital segment's profitability amid competition.
kpis.signal: Gradual improvement in segment profitability driven by contract wins and volume increases.

kpis.name: Health Civil Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin of the Health Civil segment, the most profitable segment providing managed healthcare services.
kpis.description: Indicator of the strong profitability of the Health Civil segment, a key profit driver.
kpis.signal: Highly profitable segment with continuous improvement due to operational efficiencies.

risks.title: Government Dependence
risks.score_rationale: 87% of revenue comes from U.S. government contracts. A reduction in government budgets, loss of relationships with federal agencies, or shifts in government priorities could significantly impact future revenue.

risks.title: Government Budget Reduction
risks.score_rationale: Although the presidential administration has not indicated a desire to reduce spending in defense and homeland security sectors, the scale and duration of current spending levels remain uncertain.

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.score_rationale: Trends in government procurement include a shift toward multi-award contracts using IDIQ and GSA vehicles, increasing competition and pricing pressures.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Current and future geopolitical events could negatively impact markets and government budget priorities in which the company operates.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Leidos provides critical services to the U.S. government and intelligence community. Cybersecurity breaches could impact client trust and contracts.

risks.title: International Exposure and Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: 8% of revenue comes from international markets. Changes in international laws, regulations, and trade policies could affect operations.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Leidos relies heavily on technology to deliver digital modernization, cybersecurity, and software solutions. Technological failures could impact execution capabilities.

ai_positioning.summary: Leidos identifies artificial intelligence and automation as key components of its digital transformation and operational efficiency strategy. The company leverages AI to enhance business processes through its Enterprise Transformation Office.
evidence: continual improvements in the effectiveness and efficiency of our business processes driven by our enterprise transformation office leveraging artificial intelligence and automation
